stem: Byron has offered a weak thesis for his paper. Which of the following could replace sentence 9 and provide a more effective thesis statement for this paper?

options.label: A
options.text: Before long they realized that they had found the city of Thonis-Heracleion.

options.label: B
options.text: In time they realized that they had actually found what was a very ancient city.

options.label: C
options.text: At first no one knew exactly what had been discovered, but there was plenty of curiosity.

options.label: D
options.text: In the end it just happened to be the place and the city of Thonis-Heracleion.
